ICS 73.100.40MED 08Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPELays down the requirements for rope cappels for use with haulage ropes to attach the haulage rope with tub/mine car or a set of mine tubs or mine cars or any other means of conveyance.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below.
